record.question: Which, among the following is not emphasised in the NCF 2005 for schools?
record.explanation: The printed page 8 confirms the stem and options. Value Education is the likely intended choice: NCF 2005 names Language, Mathematics and Science as curricular areas, while addressing ethical development through Education for Peace (sections 3.1-3.3 and 3.8; https://www.ncert.nic.in/pdf/nc-framework/nf2005-english.pdf). However, the wording is defective: the framework does emphasise values, so this answer depends on interpreting the question as asking about separately named curricular areas.
